beats.event: Age 10, family relocates from Bronxville to Kingman, Arizona
Mother cultivates a love of literature via college reading lists
Earns degrees in English literature and biology at Stanford
Studies history and philosophy of science at Cambridge
Enters Yale Medical School; meets future wife Lucy
Obstetrics rotation: witnesses first birth and death together
Adapts to the field; joins a neuroscience lab
Sixth year: professional recognition; found his place
EGFR mutation found; Tarceva offers a treatment option
Initial improvement lets him return to the operating room
New scans reveal tumor growth; chemo proves ineffective
Daughter Cady is born on July 4, 2014
Dies in intensive care; Lucy writes the epilogue
